lines: In sky properly from standing sky-called Khecarī held; from union of two fists in heart she called heart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samyagvyomasu saṃsthānādvyomākhyā khecarī matā muṣṭidvitayasaṅghaṭṭāddhṛdi sā hṛdayāhvāyā
